correctness.rationale: The exact fixed-damping mode equals AR(2) with determinant (1+a)^-2, characteristic trace phi, independent Gaussian innovation of variance a^3 sigma^2/(1+a)^4. Jury stability is Delta_t(a)>0. Yule-Walker gives V_t(a)=sigma^2(a^2+2a+2)/[t(a+2)Delta_t(a)]. Differentiating yields F_t(a)=B(a)(t-T(a)), with B(a)>0. The factored T derivative has exactly one positive root, 1+sqrt(3), and its minimum is (4+12sqrt(3))/13. Boundary classifications follow on the entire stable domain. Exact rational signs J'(1)=-10881433/143273691, J'(4)=40729/114967512, J'(20)=-2559661/557646408 prove a full-system reversal. The actual standalone verify.py independently solves state covariance in rational arithmetic on a stable parameter grid and confirms 299 checks; finite tests support but do not replace the analytic proof.
